title: False positive: normal platforming movement flagged as sudden jump
reproduction_steps: Play through the floating-platform level using left/right/jump inputs
Character moves across platforms, jumps, and traverses the visible level normally
Compare pixel_diff_median (22.155) to clean_play_median_diff (22.924) - nearly identical
suspected_cause: The character's normal movement and camera pan across platform sections likely produced a large pixel-diff magnitude that tripped the sudden_jump heuristic, but the diff median is in line with clean play and frames show continuous, coherent traversal rather than a discontinuity.
evidence_note: Frames 19->27->35->43 show smooth, logical progression: character walks left, jumps across a gap, lands on a platform, then continues right while collecting coins. No teleport, texture pop, or scene break is visible; motion is consistent with the action_sequence of lefts/rights/jumps.
